data.name: Vidur
data.gender_notes: Vidur is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root vid, 'to know' — vidura, 'wise'. Its root is Sanskrit vid (विद्). Vidura, the wise counsellor in the Mahabharata. Vidur is a Sanskrit name meaning “Wise; intelligent; a counsellor”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vidur expresses “Wise; intelligent; a counsellor”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root vid, 'to know' — vidura, 'wise'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vidur total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

vedic_reference.note: Vidur is a renowned sage and a key character in the Indian epic Mahabharata. He is known for his vast knowledge, wisdom, and his role as the advisor to the Pandava brothers.
